---
title: "Workflows and Onboarding"
---

## Workflow model for 2026

- Workflow files are stored as disabled by default in the template (`*.yml.disabled`).
- Team leader activation renames them to `.yml` and pushes once.
- `classroom.yml` is then triggered by classroom infrastructure events.
- `create-issues.yml` is manually triggered by students from the GitHub Actions tab.

## Enable and run issue import

1. Team leader runs:

```bash
bash validconfig.sh --activate-workflows
```

2. Open the repository on GitHub.
3. Go to the Actions tab.
4. Select `Import issues from Template`.
5. Click `Run workflow` on branch `main`.
6. Wait for completion, then confirm issues are visible in the Issues tab.

## Team coordination rule

Only one teammate should trigger issue import during onboarding.

After issue creation:

1. Teammate who triggered it announces completion.
2. Everyone pulls latest changes locally.
3. Team starts milestone 1 implementation.

## Quick link from local repo to Actions page

If your remote is:

```bash
git remote get-url origin
```

Then your actions URL is:

- HTTPS remote: `https://github.com/<org>/<repo>/actions`
- SSH remote: `git@github.com:<org>/<repo>.git` becomes `https://github.com/<org>/<repo>/actions`

## Known caveat

Classroom repositories are private and can have workflow behavior differences across academic years. If `Import issues from Template` is not visible, the team leader should notify the teacher immediately.
